title: Nutty Sweet Kenyan Beef Stew
description: A cultured and velvety Kenyan dish featuring praline-french and ferment-kimchi flavors, made keto-friendly with careful ingredient selection.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef short ribs until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the praline paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the kimchi, beef broth, and browned short ribs to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 1/2 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
